Kai: Hey team :wave: I'm Kai — starting today on Platform. I keep a 40-gallon reef tank (lots of tiny coral buddies), I do air-guitar at parties, and I make small-batch kimchi. Hybrid schedule: SF office Tue/Thu. Where do I grab my badge? Low-key planning a lunch board-game night if folks are down.

Tara: Welcome Kai! :tada: Badge pickup is at security on the 1st floor — tell them 'Kai Chen' or show your ID. We'll ping when your workstation is ready. Board-game lunch sounds amazing.

hr-bot: Welcome to Redwood, Kai! Your onboarding checklist was emailed. HR will trigger security for badge pickup — expect confirmation in ~30 min. Onboarding hub: https://intranet.redwood/onboard 

Oliver: Hey Kai — I'm on Platform too. Desk is by the windows (3rd row from the kitchen). If you want a power strip or monitor arm, shout. We have a plant shelf if you want to park a tiny coral terrarium (no live fish in the office pls) :seedling: 

Marta: Board-game night count me in. Tuesdays after 6? Also kimchi swap please :kimchi: 

Samir: Reef tank nerd here as well! Would love to chat lighting and ACRs sometime. Post a pic of your setup in #show-and-tell? :fish::nerd_face: 

Noor: Welcome! Quick heads up — I have a shellfish allergy. Strong seafood smells can set me off, so if anyone brings seafood to common areas please give a heads up. Not trying to be a downer, just FYI :) 

Ash: Air-guitar warmups are a yes from me. I play actual guitar too, so accidental collab incoming :guitar: 

Kai: Thanks everyone — noted on shellfish, I'll keep kimchi sealed and labeled. I'll swing by security after lunch. Photo of the tank incoming later today. Who wants to be on the invite for board-games? I'll make a quick Doodle but open to Tuesdays after 6. Also if anyone has a spare 27" monitor arm I'm happy to take it.

Tara: Adding you to the #platform seating doc and sending a calendar invite for the intro sync at 4pm. Re: monitor arm — check the spare shelf by eng-infra, tag me if you want help moving it. :calendar: 

Oliver: FYI spare Monitor Arm: serial M-Arm-18, sitting under the big fern. Help yourself and leave a note in the asset sheet. :sunglasses: 

Samir: Ping me for reef chat — happy to swap shop recs (lighting, dosing, stores). Welcome again :wave:
